lines: {target}? Empty End stone gives no comfort. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for End Barrens, tell them: Keep away from edges and watch the sky. I will be at the map table.
The void makes silence feel heavier. I will mark that beside the road home.
End Barrens is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember End Barrens as bare End land with nothing friendly in sight. I will mark the warning beside the road.
{target}? High End ground still ends in void. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for End Highlands, tell them: Mind bridges and do not chase anything floating. I will be at the map table.
Chorus fruit grows where falling is easy. I will mark that beside the road home.
End Highlands is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember End Highlands as high ground that does not feel safe. I will mark the warning beside the road.
{target}? Even the middle of the End feels lost. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for End Midlands, tell them: Mark your way and distrust the horizon. I will be at the map table.
There is no village smell in that air. I will mark that beside the road home.
End Midlands is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember End Midlands as End stone stretching where roads should be. I will mark the warning beside the road.
{target}? Small islands feel smaller beside the void. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for Small End Islands, tell them: Bridge slowly and never look proud near an edge. I will be at the map table.
End stone gives no second chances below it. I will mark that beside the road home.
Small End Islands is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember Small End Islands as little bits of ground with forever around them. I will mark the warning beside the road.
{target}? Victory there still feels far from home. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for The End, tell them: Do not anger the tall ones and keep away from the void. I will be at the map table.
End stone does not smell like any living place. I will mark that beside the road home.
The End is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember The End as a pale world with no proper village sound. I will mark the warning beside the road.
{target}? Nothing below is not the same as safety. I would mark the way home first.
If anyone heads for The Void, tell them: Stay away from edges like they owe you emeralds. I will be at the map table.
There is no road back from falling forever. I will mark that beside the road home.
The Void is no small story. A map is not courage.
I will remember The Void as empty dark where even warnings feel small. I will mark the warning beside the road.
